product.title: Multnomah Falls and Columbia River Gorge Waterfalls Tour

description.text: Escape Portland for a guided waterfall tour along the Columbia River Highway National Scenic Byway. Stops typically include Portland Women's Forum viewpoints, Wahkeena Falls, Latourell Falls, Multnomah Falls, and Horsetail Falls with hotel pickup in a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van.

highlights: Morning waterfall tour along the Columbia River Highway
Visit Multnomah Falls, Latourell Falls, and Horsetail Falls
Stop at Vista House and Portland Women's Forum viewpoints
Hotel pickup and drop-off in downtown Portland
Shared or private tour options when booking

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Escape Portland for a guided waterfall tour along the Columbia River Highway National Scenic Byway.

itineraryItems.title: Portland hotel pickup
itineraryItems.description: Board the Sprinter from a downtown hotel within the scheduled pickup window.

itineraryItems.title: Portland Women's Forum viewpoint
itineraryItems.description: Pause for wide gorge vistas along the historic highway.

itineraryItems.title: Latourell Falls and Multnomah Falls
itineraryItems.description: Visit two of the gorge's signature waterfalls with photo time.

itineraryItems.title: Horsetail Falls
itineraryItems.description: Finish the waterfall loop before returning to Portland.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Multnomah Falls and Columbia River Gorge Waterfalls Tour?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 3 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Portland?
faqs.answer: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point listed in your booking confirmation.
